How to play

  1. Your slime runs by itself. It speeds up slowly as you go.
  2. Tap to hop. Hold to jump higher and further.
  3. Don't touch the pink spikes: on the ground, or hanging from a low ceiling (tap, don't hold!).
  4. Jump the gaps. Ride the blue platforms over the wide ones.
  5. Score = metres run + 5 per coin.
